Nora (release-lead): Quick bulletin: Security audit team requested a 6-hour hold on any schema or auth changes starting 18:00 UTC today while they run a live probe. This is a targeted freeze only (auth, oauth-proxy, user-mgmt, token-service). Do not merge to those services during the window.
Ibrahim (security): Confirmed this is for interactive testing of token rotation. We'll scope probes to non-production canaries and will notify before hitting prod.
Felix (infra): Acknowledged. We'll pause CI/CD pipelines for those services and set maintenance flag on the deploy dashboard.
Kai (oncall): Escalation: if token errors spike >0.5% or auth latencies > 700ms for 5m, roll back to last stable and page SecurityPager.
NotifierBot: Action: freeze_applied by Nora to services [auth, oauth-proxy, token-service] at 18:03 UTC. CI hooks suspended.
Nora (release-lead): Please add a one-line note to the release train changelog: "Security audit freeze: auth-related routes held for live probe (ticket SEC-314)." I'll post a lift message when probes complete.
Ibrahim (security): ETA for probe completion ~22:00 UTC, will update earlier if finished.
Nora (release-lead): Thanks all. Closing thread for now.
